categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Industrial power supply equipment, including power control power supplies and special power supplies for various industrial applications; (2) New energy vehicle charging piles/stations. The company serves as a comprehensive industrial power supply research and manufacturing enterprise with strong competitiveness in the field of power electronics technology applications across multiple industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are based on power electronics technology, featuring power control systems using IGBT and thyristor devices as the foundation, with intelligent digital control circuits as the core. Key production methods include: (1) Power control power supply systems for applications like polysilicon reduction furnaces, single crystal furnaces, and sapphire furnaces; (2) Special power supplies including programmable DC power supplies, RF power supplies, high-voltage power supplies, and microwave power supplies; (3) Modular design approaches for charging pile power control modules and energy storage converters. The company employs self-manufacturing of core components combined with external procurement of non-standard parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves multiple industries with primary customers including: (1) Photovoltaic industry (49.08% of 2024 revenue) - serving polysilicon, silicon wafer, and battery manufacturers; (2) Semiconductor and electronic materials industry (19.69% of revenue) - serving semiconductor equipment manufacturers and material producers; (3) Other industrial sectors (31.23% of revenue) - including steel metallurgy, glass/fiberglass, and research institutions. Key customer types include major equipment manufacturers, semiconductor fabs, and scientific research institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Deyang, Sichuan Province. It has established research and development centers in Deyang, Chengdu, and Shenzhen. The company has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in the UK (INJET(UK) LTD.) and Singapore (Energy 360 PTE.LTD.) for overseas business development. Domestic operations span multiple provinces, while international presence is growing in Europe and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures power supply equipment and control systems that are supplied to equipment manufacturers in upstream industries (photovoltaic, semiconductor, metallurgy). The company is positioned as a critical component supplier providing specialized power control solutions to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) rather than end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening technology innovation in power electronics with focus on semiconductor device power supplies, advanced process compatibility (5nm and above); (2) Expanding into new energy vehicle charging infrastructure with development of high-power, high-efficiency charging solutions; (3) Developing energy storage and hydrogen production technologies; (4) Pursuing international market expansion, particularly in Europe and Asia; (5) Enhancing product quality through APQP systems and CNAS certification; (6) Optimizing manufacturing capabilities through smart manufacturing upgrades. R&D investment increased to 7.67% of revenue in 2024.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized industrial power supply equipment and charging infrastructure. Revenue recognition occurs: (1) For products requiring installation/commissioning - upon customer acceptance after testing; (2) For products not requiring installation - upon customer receipt confirmation; (3) For export sales - upon shipment and customs clearance. The company operates on a project-based, made-to-order business model with long sales cycles and significant contract values.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic comprehensive industrial power supply manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities. In the photovoltaic sector, it competes with other specialized power supply manufacturers. In semiconductors, it competes with both domestic and international equipment suppliers. The company emphasizes technological differentiation, customization capabilities, and quality advantages. It faces increasing competition from international equipment giants and emerging domestic competitors, particularly in semiconductor and charging infrastructure markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized industrial equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.78 billion yuan (0.59% growth from 2023). Net profit attributable to parent company was 322.76 million yuan (down 25.19% YoY). The company has shown strong growth trajectory since IPO in 2020, with revenue growing from 1.28 billion yuan in 2022 to 1.78 billion yuan in 2024. Total assets reached 4.02 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company maintains healthy profitability with 38.5% gross margin, though facing margin pressure from industry competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Advanced power electronics technology platform enabling rapid customization and product development across multiple applications; (2) High precision and reliability in power control systems meeting stringent industrial requirements; (3) Comprehensive solutions combining hardware, software, and control systems; (4) Strong technical support and after-sales service capabilities; (5) Proven track record with major customers in photovoltaic, semiconductor, and industrial sectors; (6) Continuous innovation in emerging areas like high-power charging and energy storage. The company differentiates through technical excellence, customization capability, and deep industry expertise rather than cost competition.
